meta.title: Recreate Order: Edit More Details
gaps: Verify that the recreated event's participants are pre-filled with the old event's participant identities or selection state.
Verify that the recreated event's terms and conditions are pre-filled with the old event's exact contents.
Verify that every old-event field is preserved on the full create screen beyond the template, line-item count, and rendered sheet columns.

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ's project summary without searching the events list.
Open the stage Settings action that launches the Recreate Order flow.
Confirm the Recreate Order popup opened with the Product Sheet option.
Confirm the popup includes Auction Configurations.
Confirm the popup includes Delivery Date.
Confirm the popup includes the scheduling choice.
Choose the path that should open the full editable create screen.
Verify that Edit More Details opened the full event create screen.
Verify the recreated screen has a template applied rather than an empty template picker.
Verify the old RFQ's single product line item was carried into the recreated event.
Verify the recreated pricing sheet rendered with the expected product and pricing columns.
Confirm the recreated create screen exposes its participant configuration section.
Confirm the recreated create screen exposes its terms and conditions section.
